preconditions.description: The input word has a length between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' or 'A' <= c <= 'Z' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input word consists only of uppercase and lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: upper_count = sum(1 for c in stdin.strip() if 'A' <= c <= 'Z'); lower_count = sum(1 for c in stdin.strip() if 'a' <= c <= 'z'); expected = stdin.strip().upper() if upper_count > lower_count else stdin.strip().lower(); stdout.strip() == expected
postconditions.description: The output is the input word converted to uppercase if it has strictly more uppercase letters than lowercase letters, otherwise converted to lowercase.
